newsitem.title: FINLAND: Neste's Borealis says to invest FIM 96 mln.
newsitem.headline: Neste's Borealis says to invest FIM 96 mln.

text.p: Finnish Neste's and Norwegian Statoil's jointly owned petrochemicals firm Borealis said in a statement on Monday it would invest 96 million markka in its cable products plant in Antwerp, Belgium.
"This investment will incease the capacity of the Antwerp plant's compounds production to 170,000 tonnes from 120,000 tonnes per year," it said.
"This is an important project which will strengthen our position in the global wire and cable market and as such ensure further growth opportunities," it said.
The project would start immediately and the in-line compounding facility would be ready by the end of the first quarter of 1999, it said.
The investment would also enable Borealis to carry out its previously announced closure of its compounding facilities on the right bank of the river Schelde, it said.
